options_evaluated: Virgin ABS plastic with internal ribbing
decisions.trade_off: Balancing mechanical durability and impact resistance (to prevent premature product failure) against the carbon footprint of virgin polymers and the downcyclability of composite materials.
decisions.rationale: PCR PC/ABS offers a significantly lower carbon footprint than virgin resins while retaining the high impact strength, stiffness, and flame retardancy necessary for a durable vacuum cleaner housing, ensuring a long product life without relying on fossil-fuel-dense virgin plastics.
decisions.design_action: Investigate the supply chain availability and consistency of high-quality PCR PC/ABS resins that meet UL 94 flame retardancy standards.

options_evaluated: Threaded metal inserts with steel screws
Snap-fits integrated into the PCR-plastic housing
decisions.trade_off: Ease of high-speed automated assembly (welding) versus ease of non-destructive disassembly for repair, maintenance, and end-of-life material separation.
decisions.recommendation: Threaded metal inserts with standardized steel screws
decisions.rationale: While ultrasonic welding reduces assembly time and part count, it prevents non-destructive disassembly. Standardized screws allow users or technicians to easily open the unit to replace worn components (like seals or wiring) and cleanly separate plastics from electronics at end-of-life.
decisions.design_action: Verify the compatibility of standard screw sizes across all major structural joints to minimize the variety of tools required for disassembly.

decisions.trade_off: Operational energy efficiency and motor lifespan versus the environmental impact of mining and processing rare-earth magnets (neodymium) used in high-efficiency BLDC motors.
decisions.rationale: A BLDC motor dramatically increases energy efficiency (reducing use-phase energy consumption) and extends the vacuum's lifespan (no brushes to wear out), offsetting the initial ecological footprint of the motor's electronics and magnets over the product lifecycle.
decisions.design_action: Investigate motor suppliers that offer certified conflict-free or recycled-content neodymium magnets, or evaluate the feasibility of a magnet-free synchronous reluctance option.

options_evaluated: Active cooling fan integrated into the main motor shaft
Passive heat sinking with aluminum fins and ventilation slots
decisions.trade_off: Active cooling increases noise and energy consumption slightly but prevents thermal degradation of components, whereas passive cooling uses no operational energy but requires larger material mass (aluminum) and limits compact design.
decisions.recommendation: Active cooling via an optimized, integrated motor-shaft fan combined with strategic ventilation paths
decisions.rationale: Utilizing the motor's existing rotational energy for active cooling minimizes extra component count and weight (unlike heavy passive aluminum heat sinks), effectively preventing thermal stress on the motor and electronics, thereby maximizing product lifespan.
decisions.design_action: Check regulatory airflow and noise limits (e.g., EU eco-design requirements) to establish boundary conditions for the ventilation path geometry.

options_evaluated: Modular cartridge-based architecture (separate motor, battery, and filtration modules)
decisions.trade_off: Modular architectures increase initial material usage, weight, and volume (due to separate housings and connectors) but significantly lower the barrier to repair, part replacement, and component-level recycling.
decisions.recommendation: Modular cartridge-based architecture for high-wear components (battery pack, motor assembly, and filter unit)
decisions.rationale: Vacuum cleaners frequently fail due to battery degradation or motor burnout. A modular design allows consumers to swap out these specific modules without discarding the entire appliance, drastically extending the product's useful life.
decisions.design_action: Investigate standard connector interfaces and locking mechanisms to ensure robust electrical and mechanical connections between modules without adding excessive weight.

options_evaluated: Removable and standardized Lithium-ion (Li-ion) battery pack
decisions.trade_off: Corded power offers unlimited runtime and avoids battery manufacturing/disposal impacts but limits user convenience, whereas cordless offers convenience but introduces high-impact battery chemistry with a limited cycle life.
decisions.recommendation: Removable and standardized Lithium-ion (Li-ion) battery pack
decisions.rationale: While corded power has a lower manufacturing footprint, market demand strongly favors cordless. Choosing a removable, standardized battery pack mitigates the environmental downside by allowing battery replacement (preventing premature product disposal when cells degrade) and potential cross-compatibility with other household tools.
decisions.design_action: Verify the availability of open-standard battery platforms or partners to assess the feasibility of sharing a battery ecosystem with other appliances.
